timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 50-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.71, creatinine 0.78, hemoglobin 13.3, platelets 231, sodium 140, wbc 6.3; vitals dbp 72-77, heart_rate 80-84, map 92-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 129-135, spo2 93-95, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. COPD.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.78, hemoglobin 13.2, platelets 236, sodium 140, wbc 6; vitals dbp 73-77, heart_rate 81-84, map 93-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 132-135, spo2 93-94, temp 36.8-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. COPD. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 50-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. COPD. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
